pattern: IM-P12 variant: tenant reports a verbal landlord approval (hearsay) for her friend to do the repair and asks the agency to commit to paying him; the landlord's only written reply is the thumbs-up
notes: Event 007 is the base mutation (the landlord's thumbs-up emoji). Appended event 008 (system 'response to tenant' prompt) and event 009, the tenant's email on Thursday 28 March 2024 at 08:47: the landlord told her by phone last night that her friend Kieran may fit a new hose and the agency will reimburse him £150; she asks the agency to confirm payment and offers to send his bank details. Nothing from the landlord supports this apart from the ambiguous emoji, and £150 is high for a shower hose. History truncated after event 009. Expected: ASK the landlord directly in writing whether she agrees to the tenant's friend doing the work and to paying £150 from her funds, or wants the agency's contractor; tell the tenant nothing can be confirmed until the landlord confirms in writing and not to go ahead on the expectation of payment; take no bank details and commit no payment. No escalation.
